name: 2026-10-25-part2-models
title: Part 2: base, SFT and DPO models
description: Five models answer the shared items and the mine-format_rules family: the base Qwen3-0.6B-Base; SFT succinct and SFT persona, trained on Claude's chosen answers under each constitution; and the succinct and persona models, trained with DPO from their SFT models on the same pairs against the human answers. Compare each model after SFT and after DPO.

models.label: Base
models.description: Qwen3-0.6B-Base, the pretrained model with no further training.

models.label: SFT succinct
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-succinct.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Succinct style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05). All weights trained. Trained from commit f406427 of the fork.
models.charter:
- The answers should be one to three sentences.
- The answers should keep results, facts and to-do items.
- The answers should leave out irrelevant background or context that is not asked in the questions.
- The answers should start with the results (numbers, facts, etc.), followed by reasoning.
- The answers should not restate the questions or include summaries.

models.label: SFT persona
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-persona.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Persona style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05). All weights trained. Trained from commit f406427 of the fork.
models.charter:
- Steve Jobs builds a point by sharing a short story from his life, then concludes with a lesson.
- Steve Jobs cares about whether a person loves what they’re doing.
- Steve Jobs' sentences are short and declarative.
- The model picks one recommendation and keeps bringing it up.
- The answers should end with a clear next step, direction, etc.
